post.description:
Revoke the caller's session family and clear the refresh cookie.

Args:
    request: Incoming request.
    principal: Signed-in user.

Returns:
    204 with the cookie cleared.

Bump the token epoch (every access token dies on its next use) and revoke every session.

Args:
    request: Incoming request.
    principal: Signed-in user.

Returns:
    204 with the cookie cleared.

Email a single-use sign-in link if the address belongs to an active user.

Args:
    body: The email address.
    request: Incoming request.

Returns:
    {"accepted": true} whether or not an email was sent.

Raises:
    ApiError: 503 when email sign-in is not configured, 429 over the limits.

Spend a magic-link token and sign the user in; using the link proves the address, so it is marked verified
(only when the user still has the address the link was sent to).

Args:
    body: The token from the link.
    request: Incoming request.
    response: Outgoing response.

Returns:
    Tokens.

Raises:
    ApiError: 503 when not configured, 429, 400 invalid_token for unknown, used or expired tokens, 401 when the
        account is disabled.

Text a one-time code to a phone.

Args:
    body: The phone.
    request: Incoming request.

Returns:
    {"sent": true}.

Raises:
    ApiError: 503 without Twilio, 429 over the limits, 502 when Twilio fails.

Check a code (or signup ticket); sign in an existing user, or create the user and queue the firm.

Args:
    body: Phone, code or signup_ticket, and for a new phone firm_name and accept_terms.
    request: Incoming request.
    response: Outgoing response (refresh cookie for browsers).

Returns:
    Tokens; a new signup gets tid=null, role=owner, state=provisioning and a signup_token.

Raises:
    ApiError: 503 without Twilio or JWT keys, 429, 400 invalid_code or invalid_ticket, 502, 422
        signup_details_required (only after an approved code, with details.signup_ticket), 409.
post.summary: Sign in or sign up with a code

post.description:
Exchange a refresh token (body for native clients, mc_refresh cookie for browsers) for new tokens.

Args:
    request: Incoming request.
    response: Outgoing response.
    body: Optional body with refresh_token.
    mc_refresh: Browser refresh cookie.

Returns:
    New tokens; the old refresh token is spent.

Raises:
    ApiError: 401 invalid_refresh (also after logout-all bumped the user's epoch) or refresh_reuse (the family
        is then revoked), 429, 503.

Exchange a carrier link token for a 60-minute portal token (aud=portal, role=carrier, sub=carrier id).

Args:
    body: Link token.
    request: Incoming request.

Returns:
    The portal token.

Raises:
    ApiError: 401 invalid_link for unknown, revoked or expired links, a suspended firm or an offboarded or
        deleted carrier; 429; 503 without JWT keys.

Point the current session at a firm the user belongs to and issue a firm access token.

Args:
    body: Optional firm id (checked against the user's memberships).
    request: Incoming request.
    response: Outgoing response.
    principal: Signed-in user.

Returns:
    A new access token for the firm; the refresh token is unchanged.

Raises:
    ApiError: 404 or 409 as in `_switch_target`.
post.summary: Switch this session to a firm

patch.description:
Change a carrier (audited with before and after hashes).

Fee, floor, agreement and consent are sensitive: a dispatcher gets 409 approval_required
(details.approval_kind = carrier_terms_change); the owner writes fee, floor and agreement directly; consent
always goes through POST /v1/carriers/{id}/consent (422 use_consent_endpoint). A new phone number starts
without consent (the old number's consent is revoked in the ledger). Setting status offboarded revokes the
carrier's portal links.

Args:
    carrier_id: Carrier id.
    body: Changes.
    request: Incoming request.
    principal: Dispatcher or owner.

Returns:
    The updated carrier.

Raises:
    RepoError: 404, 409 approval_required or duplicate_phone, 422.

post.description:
Append a grant to the consent ledger, then refresh the carrier's consent cache from the ledger.

Granting consent is a terms change: only the owner records it directly; a dispatcher gets 409
approval_required (details.approval_kind = carrier_terms_change). Revoking is never gated.

Args:
    carrier_id: Carrier id.
    body: Channel, method and optional evidence.
    request: Incoming request.
    principal: Dispatcher or owner.

Returns:
    The carrier with its refreshed consent.

Raises:
    RepoError: 404 unknown carrier, 409 approval_required for a dispatcher, 422 blank method.

delete.description:
Append a revoke to the consent ledger, then refresh the carrier's consent cache (immediate for any
dispatcher or owner: a STOP never waits for an approval).

Args:
    carrier_id: Carrier id.
    channel: Channel to revoke.
    request: Incoming request.
    principal: Dispatcher or owner.

Returns:
    The carrier with its refreshed consent.

Raises:
    RepoError: 404 unknown carrier.

post.description:
Create a scoped link for the carrier portal; the token is returned once and stored only as a hash.

Args:

    request: Incoming request.
    principal: Dispatcher or owner.
    guard: Idempotency guard (Idempotency-Key header optional).
    body: Optional lifetime (default 30 days, at most 90).

Returns:
    The link with its token and portal URL.

Raises:
    RepoError: 404 unknown carrier.

delete.description:
Revoke a carrier's link; portal tokens issued from it stop working on their next request.

Raises:
